headline: Bank of Japan Sets Timetable for US Dollar Funds-Supplying Operations
summary: The Bank of Japan published the schedule and operational timetable for its upcoming U.S. dollar funds-supplying operations.
why: Central bank foreign-currency swap lines and dollar liquidity facilities ensure domestic financial institutions maintain access to stable foreign exchange funding.

impacts.name: Japanese yen
impacts.why: Central bank dollar liquidity operations support cross-currency funding markets and foreign currency access for financial institutions.
